title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash a509a971533e… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash a509a971533ed05fff3536583fb6e39d24e98472aafa2c06da0eea6df6617e07 was observed twice on 2026-11-23 by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. The file is associated with attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) and was seen originating from attacker infrastructure in Germany. The hash corresponds to a malicious payload that could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check this hash against their environments and security tools for detection.
